goal: Shared, extensible semantics for better game-native autonomy: six needs and sustainable finances first, concurrent goal coordination and continuity across situations, with player authority and game-safe evidence gates.
authority: docs/DOCTRINE.md and AGENTS.md govern; this ontology references rather than replaces existing contract owners.

GAME_BUILD.definition: Exact Sims 4 version, platform, packs and compatibility profile.

HOST_SESSION.definition: Explicitly activated bounded agent session, never equivalent to permission to click.

GAME_SCENE.definition: Classified UI surface and permitted candidate transitions.

VIEWPORT_STATE.definition: Rendering/capture state independent of a verified game scene.

SAVE_SLOT.definition: Save with provenance-bound protection class, not inferred from its name.

HOUSEHOLD.definition: In-game household; its identity alone grants no host authority.

SIM.definition: A game character whose needs, preferences and autonomy are contextual.

PLAYER_INTENT.definition: Explicit user directive or player-directed interaction that outranks agent autonomy.

PLAYER_PRESENCE.definition: Observed activity/uncertainty that controls whether the host must yield.

NEED.definition: Hunger, bladder, energy, hygiene, fun or social motive.

NEED_STATE.definition: Time-bound and source-qualified reading of a Sim motive.

PERSONALITY.definition: Traits, likes, dislikes and style; prevents a universal robotic policy.

MOODLET.definition: Observed emotion/moodlet context; never fabricated from an uncalibrated screenshot.

LOCATION.definition: World, neighborhood, lot or indoor zone relevant to a plan.

GAME_OBJECT.definition: Target object with observed interaction availability/occupancy.

AFFORDANCE.definition: Action feasible here and now given object, scene, patch and player restrictions.

ACTION_QUEUE.definition: Observed current and pending interactions, with player-directed ownership distinction.

GOAL.definition: Needs, school, event, scenario, income, skill or career target with dependency context.

OPPORTUNITY.definition: Candidate useful interaction; benefit and availability require independent support.

OBSERVATION.definition: Captured bounded datum with source, timestamp, patch and provenance.

CLAIM.definition: Interpretation of observations with an explicit evidence status and falsifier.

ACTION_PROPOSAL.definition: Advisory suggested behavior linked to preconditions, target, expected effect and safety gates.

CONTROL_PERMIT.definition: Short-lived permission for a specific host step after presence, scene, save and opt-in checks.

HOST_ACTION.definition: Guarded attempted UI action, separate from a suggestion and from a successful outcome.

OUTCOME.definition: Observed after-state, adverse effect, or failure, not assumed from a click.

REVIEWED_JUDGMENT.definition: Explicitly consented human evaluation of context, action and outcome.

LEARNING_MODEL.definition: Bounded contextual action recommendations, advisory and never executable authority.

INCIDENT.definition: Anomaly with observations, hypotheses, falsifiers and recovery evidence.

PROOF_RECEIPT.definition: Artifact identifying exact observation, check, branch, game patch and proof ceiling.

SITUATION.definition: Time-bounded changing combination of observed game state, actors, opportunities, unknowns and currently relevant constraints.

DOMAIN_CAPABILITY.definition: Open registration of a goal/evaluation domain; no fixed allowed-domain list or automatic execution authority.

GOAL_THREAD.definition: Continuing objective with actor scope, dependencies, status and resumption context; not erased by one interrupted activity.

ACTIVITY.definition: A proposed or ongoing unit of work serving a goal; evaluation may be concurrent while game action follows actual constraints.

RESOURCE_CLAIM.definition: Scoped exclusive or shared use of time, objects, funds, attention or interaction capacity that makes candidate activities conflict or coexist.

TIME_WINDOW.definition: Observed or hypothesized interval/deadline during which an option matters; uncertainty must be recorded rather than invented.

CONTINGENCY.definition: Unexpected or time-sensitive situation that may require re-ranking goals, but never waives player or safety gates.

INTERRUPTION.definition: Recorded suspension/preemption of an activity including cause, prior intent, pending work and observations.

RESUME_CONDITION.definition: Explicit conditions to reconsider a suspended goal after a contingency without blindly replaying stale actions.

MECHANIC_PATH.definition: Game-native tuning/interaction or a justified extension through which a goal might be served, distinct from its desired outcome.

COORDINATION_CYCLE.definition: Bounded evaluation of multiple domain receipts plus shared resources, contingencies and continuity that emits advisory plans, not host permits.

VIEW_SCENE.definition: One observed camera viewpoint of a world/lot, independent of Live/Buy/Build game scene and changing with camera or floor movement.

SIM_PORTRAIT.definition: Selected active Sim identity tied to a fresh, attested household-portrait hitbox, not an arbitrary world click.

CAMERA_FOLLOW.definition: Continuing active-Sim camera attachment after right-clicking the selected portrait or verified game-camera API; distinct from one-shot Enter centering.

HUD_PANEL.definition: Exactly observed bottom-right selected Live panel identity and current UI/Sim revisions, never an inferred fixed target position.

EVENT_OVERLAY.definition: Current career/random/decision overlay that can interrupt an active queue; requires choice evaluation and attested resolution before resumption.

SCENE_MEMORY.definition: Deduplicated metadata-only, evidence-labeled viewpoint discovery requiring review before serving as a future navigation hint.

OS_PERIPHERAL_AUTHORITY.definition: Windows Bluetooth service, radio, driver, pairing and input-preference control belongs to the SysAdminSuite Windows repair boundary, never to an autonomous Sims game action or idle host permit.

OBSERVED_MENU_ROUTE.definition: Observed, bounded, source- and scene-scoped sequence of object left-click, Order and optional More Choices pages to an exact visible UI choice; no fixed page count, coordinates or automatic pointer authority.

ACQUISITION_SOURCE.definition: Specific witnessed or research-supported producer of desired stock or fuel; differentiates computer purchase, Fabricator craft, recycler generator-refill resources and insect-farm biofuel harvest.

ACTION_EFFECT_CLASS.definition: Explicit hypothesis about whether an observed in-game interaction is a possibly immediate UI change, queued production, time-gated harvest, resource conversion or unknown; a label never proves completion or grants permission.

HIGHLIGHT_OBSERVATION.definition: Source-qualified, capture-bound multi-cue evidence about whether a specific in-world object is highlighted; ABSENT is a measured cue state and may carry null highlighted-object identity. A cue, however confident, is not a host action permit.

WORLD_TARGET_TRACK.definition: Per-target and per-camera-revision continuity of a visible world object and its highlight, supported by fresh frame indices, capture identity, stable client bounding boxes and independent cues. Distinguishes LOCKED, HIGHLIGHT_LOST, transient, occluded, drift, unknown and camera/identity change; a track cannot grant a click.

WORLD_INTERACTION_ATTEMPT.definition: One independent before/after capture pair with observed target outcome and explicit player-not-interrupted attestation, used as replay-unique strategy training evidence only when source-qualified. Prediction, pointer proposal and game-input attempt are not independent success evidence.

EFFECT_ADMISSION_CLASS.definition: Whether a proposed operation is trusted read-only observation, background reasoning, a human-gated screen/game effect, forbidden host OS configuration or unclassified. It is distinct from in-game acquisition/action effect categories; a label alone does not grant execution.

PASSIVE_BACKGROUND_LANE.definition: An explicitly reviewed, bounded, active-session read-only callback that never acquires the operator desktop lease, sends input, takes focus, mutates game/saves or changes host settings. Its classification is not a Python sandbox.

HUMAN_CONTROL_RECLAIM.definition: Physical human input in any application, or explicit operator busy/playing, invalidates automated focus and action admission at the next cooperative checkpoint. A prior idle/foreground permit is not transferable.

OS_INPUT_CAPABILITY.definition: Operator-owned Bluetooth, screenshot key, Escape/U mappings, keyboard accessibility, hotkeys, global hooks and pointer services. A game permission cannot mutate or seize host-device configuration.

AGENT_ADOPTION_COVERAGE.definition: Evidence that each registered BetterInstincts or Cursor input path honors the relevant player-first checks; registry/static/CI proof must remain distinct from local Windows activation and unadopted external-agent runtime control.

NAVIGATION_SCOPE.definition: Opaque save/household/lot/actor/game-build/scene/graph revision tuple. Navigation history is never reused across a changed scope.

NAVIGATION_REGION.definition: Verified on-lot spatial region with floor and observation provenance, distinct from a rendered viewport or camera direction.

NAVIGATION_PASSAGE.definition: Explicitly independently verified Sim-walkable directed connection between regions; visual adjacency, pixel overlap, or a camera pan is insufficient.

NAVIGATION_FRONTIER.definition: Unvisited but already verified on-lot region reachable from the current region by verified passages, suitable for bounded discovery.

NAVIGATION_INTENT.definition: Preserved actor-scoped named navigation objective and target, not permission to move or swap active portraits.

NAVIGATION_PROGRESS.definition: Fresh, scope-bound, independently evidenced region discovery, target proximity or objective outcome; movement alone is not progress.

NAVIGATION_STALL.definition: Repeated no-progress position/region cycle (including A-B-A-B) or exhausted transition budget that blocks blind replay.

NAVIGATION_RECOVERY.definition: Re-anchor and replan using a verified alternative, or abstain without OS/game effects when evidence is stale or blocked.

GAMEPLAY_IMPLEMENTATION_ROUTE.definition: An explicit reviewed choice between EA native tuning, verified in-game Python hooks, pure policy, bounded host-lab observation, or non-game behavior; the chosen route cannot grant game effect authority.

NATIVE_MECHANIC_EVIDENCE.definition: Patch-pinned EA source or script API provenance, packaged mod identity and independently observed in-game behavior/rollback. Offline code and host UI clicks are not native gameplay proof.

HOST_LAB_BOUNDARY.definition: Explicit temporary host UI/capture and diagnostics may support read-only reconnaissance, onboarding and disposable testing under player and save admission, but never substitute for EA-native gameplay mechanics.

PERIPHERAL_IDENTITY_EVIDENCE.definition: Read-only Bluetooth endpoint sightings, appearance, names, HID matching, physical button/movement confirmation and transition history; a generic Mouse appearance/name cannot identify a physical endpoint or grant pairing permission.

AGENT_EFFECT_PERIMETER.definition: All executable repository launchers, agent hooks, workflows, scripts and future adapters inherit operator-owned device and input boundaries; static scanning is distinct from runtime sandbox or effective host hook.

invariants.rule: Any user-chosen game, mod, mouse, keyboard, voice, assistive or other-app interaction outranks autonomous effects. Unknown presence yields. Inactivity permits re-evaluation, never a stale action replay.
Unknown and user saves are protected; lab-looking names are never proof of authorization.
No latest-patch fallback, cross-build evidence promotion, or changes to older certified profile bytes.
A scene classification needs two genuinely source-distinct observations; placeholders are not observations.
Ambiguous scene, presence, action availability, provenance or patch prevents execution.
Observation, confidence, learned score and evaluator PASS never grant SendInput rights.
Only explicit operator-reviewed semantic judgments may train; learned output remains advisory.
Intent, planned action, attempted click, observed outcome and game certification are separate statuses.
Six needs precede sustainable income, skills and career; preserve rest, personality and fun.
No implicit background recorder, hidden daemon, telemetry, auto-training or unbounded polls.
A dark frame alone does not prove Live mode; keep alternative diagnoses and test recovery safely.
Offline tests are not playable-mod certification; BI-002's real vanilla/modified gameplay gate remains open.
Prefer improving native Sims mechanics; permit separately justified creative extensions and engineering approaches. Game-native preference never licenses unsafe actions.
Preemption preserves the affected goal, reason, state and recheck/resume condition; never silently discards or blindly replays an earlier action.
Domain evaluations may run in tandem but cannot treat shared time, object access, attention or player-controlled queues as unlimited concurrent game actions.
Urgent time-sensitive events may trigger bounded reprioritization only on supported observations; hypothetical events never manufacture host authority.
Sim, household and world scales and future domains are extensions, not exclusive competing centers; a closed capability list is not product doctrine.
Score claimed utility and completion from observed outcomes, not merely a selected proposal or attempted interaction; no offline pass as game certificate.
Follow is only available for a fresh exact selected active Sim portrait with current independent cues and native host admission. Enter is one-shot center only and Shift+Enter centers the lot.
Camera follows active Sim by default; only a verified named current goal permits bounded map viewing, after which the active Sim is reobserved and restored.
Career/random overlays cannot silently discard or replay action-queue goals; current independently observed choices must be ranked/admitted and clearing confirmed before resumption.
Off-target viewpoints are distinct deduplicated records; review is required before reuse, and even reviewed records never grant map/click authority without fresh observations.

Any user-chosen game, mod, mouse, keyboard, voice, assistive or other-app interaction outranks autonomous effects. Unknown presence yields. Inactivity permits re-evaluation, never a stale action replay.
Prefer independently verified native semantic APIs. Desktop fallback requires operator opt-in. No focus capture for observation or peripheral preference/security changes to aid automation.

Game-side agents, native APIs, capture and screen permits cannot configure Bluetooth services, radio/driver PnP, pairing or OS input preferences. Unknown effects fail closed and authorized Windows diagnosis routes to SysAdminSuite, with cause hypotheses separate from observed recovery.

Reinspect a menu after each More Choices; choose an exact observed option, bound depth and reject repeated menu signatures. A historical two-click observation never authorizes an unseen option or hardcoded screen coordinate.

Every acquisition is scoped to a freshly observed portrait and available source/pack; no instant-class promotion or inventory/fuel credit without observed destination delta. Crafting, recycling, fuel refill, and insect harvest are distinct from computer Order; user screen control and unrelated saves remain sovereign.

World-target highlight status requires at least two ordered fresh, distinct host captures on the same target and camera revision with two independent supported cues per frame and stable bounds. Two ABSENT observations may carry null highlight identity and yield HIGHLIGHT_LOST; PRESENT without target identity cannot lock. Flicker, camera/target change, occlusion, unknown and stale evidence withhold click candidates. Any LOCKED is only framing evidence, never CONTROL_PERMIT.

Only independently attested observed post-action outcome with explicit player_interrupted=false can train a contextual strategy; exact game-version and pre-action capture fingerprint is unique across training sessions and heldout evaluation. Legacy counts without replay provenance and exhausted bounded history fail closed. An advisory ranking, synthetic score or labeled fixture cannot authorize cursor input, mutate OS/user data or certify screenshot accuracy or Sims gameplay.

P08 world-highlight sensor measurement is a supporting live evidence lane, not BI-002 completion or a prerequisite to the needs-first product gate. One authorized local Sims screen owner runs sensor, independent click outcome, then reviewed adapter integration in sequence, yields to any human activity, and refuses saves, off-lot/stale camera clicks, OS peripheral mutations or unreviewed takeover of an active spatial-perception writer. CI/PR/fixtures never substitute for local installed evidence.

Every automation entrypoint must classify an operation as read-only background, human-gated screen/game effect, denied host configuration or unclassified; unknown and OS settings never inherit a player-idle permission.

Trusted bounded passive observation and planning may proceed during physical human activity only without screen/focus/game mutation. The background queue is not a bypass for input, saves or privacy; callback type alone is no sandbox.

Human input from any app or explicit busy signal blocks focus borrowing and subsequent game input. Two fresh trusted idle probes precede focus; game foreground and a second confirmation are required before one effect. Unknown presence fails closed.

Bluetooth services, driver/adapter, Print Screen, Escape/U remapping, accessibility, global input interception and Windows registry configuration are out of BetterInstincts game authority regardless of agent frustration or idle state.

Every adopted screen/game entrypoint must have a reviewed owner, fresh per-effect gate and durable harness check; static inventory, CI, merge, workstation installation and live physical takeover are independent proof states. Unadopted tools and mid-call interruption remain unproven.

A camera pan, viewport direction, pixel distance or visual relative lot-floor-map graph edge is never a verified Sim-walkable NAVIGATION_PASSAGE; physical routing needs source-verified on-lot adjacency and reachability.
Every navigation proposal must bind opaque game/household/lot/actor/scene/graph scope, preserve named objective and deterministic tie-breakers; no shared history across profiles, Sims or saves.

Movement or capture repetition does not constitute NAVIGATION_PROGRESS; no-progress A-B-A-B, repeated unsuccessful edges and exhausted budgets trigger bounded replanning or abstention, never automatic retrigger.
Navigation is proposal-only, cannot grant CONTROL_PERMIT, issue camera/game/OS input, mutate saves or borrow focus; human-presence uncertainty and stale scene/target evidence fail closed.

Discovery/frontier coverage is only for reachable verified on-lot regions; unknown regions, walls, locked doors, stair transitions or off-lot space are not silently promoted to traversable graph edges.
A GOAL_ROUTING arrival is not interaction completion; actual outcome requires separate world-target, action-queue, game scene and player-authority evidence before goal closure.

Sim autonomy, motives, queued goals, careers and other ongoing gameplay mechanics must use verified EA tuning or exact-build native script interfaces for installed gameplay; desktop input may only assist bounded host-lab workflows, never act as a silent substitute.

Every changed product Python implementation must declare a machine-reviewed route and owned paths in the PR, classifying non-game/host-lab/policy/native paths; unclassified changes fail the native authority checker.

Offline policy or host interaction evidence never establishes a playable EA-native mechanic; installed and live claims require exact game patch, verified native source, independent gameplay observation and rollback.

Native scoring or script integration must still preserve explicit player queue, unknown action origin, urgent needs, socially beneficial actions, gameplay version compatibility, protected saves and opt-in; native is a mechanism, not blanket execution permission.

Every executable launcher, script, agent hook, CI workflow and newly added adapter must fail review for Windows service, radio, pairing, driver, registry, global input interception or user input-preference mutation. A game/control permit never grants these effects.

Bluetooth appearance 962/Mouse and an early generic Mouse label are classification evidence only; do not infer endpoint continuity, a specific physical mouse, safe pairing or absence of nearby other mice without observed identity and HID plus physical corroboration.

A physically working mouse, service/adapter recovery, a source test, provider hook configuration and local hook interception are independently evidenced. No AI blame, Windows incident causal proof or cross-harness enforcement without correlated observations and actual local activation.

interpretation_rules: An OBSERVATION has a source, capture reference, timestamp, exact patch/platform and independent-vs-correlated provenance.
A CLAIM is not a fact merely because it was repeated in agent prose; include evidence_state and possible falsifier.
A GOAL may rank opportunities, but never bypass PLAYER_INTENT, SAVE_SLOT, GAME_SCENE or CONTROL_PERMIT.
A LEARNING_MODEL may recommend only and cannot upgrade a HYPOTHESIS, acquire CONTROL_PERMIT or mark GAME_CERTIFIED.
An absent/outdated ontology mapping is a reason to document and reconcile the semantic gap before prototyping; it is not license to fabricate a concept.
A GOAL_THREAD belongs to an actor/scope and outlives a particular ACTIVITY; interruption records a reason and revalidation before any resume.
DOMAIN_CAPABILITY is open-world metadata, not a closed enumeration of Sims 4 mechanics; a candidate extension cannot bypass player, save, scene, build or host admission.
Parallel evaluation does not imply simultaneous exclusive object use or parallel SendInput; selection remains a proposal until separately authorized.
A CONTINGENCY's urgency, deadline and possible action path are hypotheses until supported by real game/version observations; no universal burglar behavior assumption.
A HIGHLIGHT_OBSERVATION about a world target never proves that a click was sent or would affect the intended GAME_OBJECT; WORLD_TARGET_TRACK LOCKED is independent of CONTROL_PERMIT.

A WORLD_INTERACTION_ATTEMPT used for training must be replay-unique and independently outcome-labeled; click proposal, model recommendation, frame count, or repeated holdout evidence is not success or game certification.
The WORLD_SENSOR P08 support priority cannot replace BI-002 hunger; only a separate operator-authorized local game host can acquire actual screen measurements.

Lot-floor-map ADJACENT and camera direction hints are descriptive spatial observations, not Sim route evidence. NAVIGATION_PASSAGE requires a separately verified, explicitly scoped walkable transition.
A deterministic household navigation suggestion is not permission for mouse, keyboard, save or game effects; a stalled or human-interrupted route must preserve intent and abstain.

An early Bluetooth Mouse label or appearance code 962 cannot distinguish multiple nearby mice or prove stable endpoint identity. A later full name requires temporal correlation; transition mechanism remains UNKNOWN until traced.
A static source guard and repository-local agent hook are independent evidence states; neither makes a game agent the Windows repair authority or intercepts unadopted external tools.

mutation_consultation.trigger: Before drafting behavior-changing prototypes, tuning, agent plans, host click paths or learning-policy mutations; then repeat during review and before merge.

migration: Add new evidence and concept revisions with provenance; never rewrite previously certified patch-specific evidence. Change semantic identifiers only by versioned migration and regression review.

product_identity.mission: Improve The Sims 4's natural autonomy and ability to sustain needs, income, character and other responsibilities without constant player micromanagement.
product_identity.foundation: Game-native mechanics first, not exclusively; observable value, safety and compatibility decide when extensions are justified.
core_challenge: asynchronous coordination across all current and future domains
product_identity.capability_ceiling: OPEN; no concept, list of domains, level of agency or implementation technology is a prohibition unless an explicit owned safety or compatibility rule applies.
product_identity.architecture_policy: Ontology defines shared meanings, invariants and interfaces; it must not prescribe a scheduler, one Sim/household/world as exclusive center, or a closed list of modules.
non_goals: game action without a separate control permit
trading personality or player intent for throughput

orchestration_contract.program_seam: Existing domain_cascade is the cross-domain poll owner; existing need_load_balance is the needs resource-health owner; semantic advisory layer composes receipts and goal-thread continuity without replacing either.
success_stack: bounded observation and validated scene/build/presence context
semantic advisory weighs open-domain goals, resource conflicts, time windows and contextual contingencies
separate screen_admit checks player/save/scene/build and issues at most one-step permit
host executor attempts authorized game action and records separately observed outcome
failure_stack: uncertain scene/build, player present or unapproved save => no host action
resource conflict => defer activity, preserve goal thread
failed or stale activity => keep goal, reset assumptions, reassess rather than blindly retry
orchestration_contract.control_boundary: No semantic advisory score, learned preference, goal priority, or emergency label grants CONTROL_PERMIT.
orchestration_contract.scales: sim, household, world or future actor scope are optional, extensible labels; no central actor class is exclusive.

interaction_policy.rule: Any user-chosen game, mod, mouse, keyboard, voice, assistive or other-app interaction outranks autonomous effects. Unknown presence yields. Inactivity permits re-evaluation, never a stale action replay.
limits: Cooperative adapters only; external raw input is not intercepted.
Already executing native calls cannot be forcibly preempted.
No new global hooks, UAC changes, scheduler or background service.
interaction_policy.admission_rule: Unknown/OS_CONFIGURATION denied; read-only background requires explicit trusted callback and active session; UI/game effects require scoped consent, idle >=15000ms, lock, fresh target and game context; focus rechecks before/after borrow.
